text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Bahrain's Hafeera Contracting Co is engaging in a five million dinar project with the Korea-based Hyundai Pipe Co to produce pipes. The project had been delayed for seven months.
- A South African trade delegation has delayed a visit to Bahrain and is now scheduled to arrive in March.
- Bahrain Petroleum Company is to shut down its unit number four for maintenance in July. The unit produces around 104,000 barrels per day.
- An Austrian delegation is to visit Bahrain in March to discuss setting up new hotels.
- Cement sales in Bahrain dropped six percent in 1996 because of slow construction.
